titre: Dans le monde, les prix de la property reculent de 12 % pendant que la casualty gagne encore 2 %
sous_titre: Variation des prix de l'assurance d'entreprise dans le monde, deuxième trimestre 2026, en %

Property.texte: Property rates declined by 12% globally, following 9% decreases in Q1 2026 and Q4 2025.

Cyber.texte: Cyber insurance rates declined by 4% globally

Lignes financières et professionnelles.texte: Financial and professional lines rates decreased 3%, compared to a 5% decrease in the prior quarter.

Casualty.texte: Casualty rates increased 2% globally, down from a 3% increase in Q1.

Ensemble des branches.texte: global commercial insurance rates fell, on average, by 6% in the second quarter of 2026, following a 5% decline in Q1 2026.
